note: A24's first attempt is archived unscored. Its value is diagnostic: it is the evidence that an at-cap admission pin loses a race it cannot win by polling.

attempts.why_archived: Two independent faults, neither of them the arm's. (1) It launched 102 s after topic-2 H2-review resumed, so two Opus arms were admitting; I pinned it 13 s in. (2) The pin did not hold: the account session limit killed job after job in about 7 s each, and every $0 settlement reopened headroom between the maintainer's 3 s re-pins, so the campaign admitted through those windows and spent all 24 admissions. 21 of 24 jobs are cli_error.
attempts.what_it_proved: The at-cap pin loses a race it cannot win by polling: the maintainer re-pinned 18 times, held committed at exactly $300.00 every time, and admissions still passed through windows of $0.27 to $7.78. That is why hold_admissions gained a race-free `strict` mode.
